drivers: Refinery attacks and outages (Ras Tanura, Samara, Deer Park)
Americas heavy oil glut from freight squeeze
outlooks.summary: Refinery outages and Gulf disruptions are bullish, but a heavy oil glut in the Americas and coal switching risk offset them. Price is down 16% in 3 months and the supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the restart pace of Gulf Coast output after the storm and any further strikes on Middle East or Russian refineries.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂停产和墨西哥湾扰动偏多,但美洲重质原油过剩以及向煤炭转换的风险形成对冲。价格三个月下跌16%,供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 炼厂袭击与停产(拉斯塔努拉、萨马拉、迪尔帕克)
运费高企导致美洲重质原油过剩
石油焦上涨后转用煤炭的风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注风暴过后美国墨西哥湾沿岸产能的恢复速度,以及中东或俄罗斯炼厂是否再遭袭击。

drivers: Fed rate hike fears and strong dollar
Gold at 14-month low, down sharply from record
outlooks.summary: Gold is driven by macro factors, not supply. Headlines point to heavy selling, so a supply-shortage price upside looks unlikely.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed policy signals and US dollar and yield moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 金价主要受宏观因素而非供应驱动。新闻显示抛售严重,因供应短缺而上涨的可能性不大。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
金价触及14个月低点,较纪录高位大幅回落
ETF资金流出
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美联储下一步政策信号以及美元和收益率走势。

drivers: DRC reimposes cobalt export ban from Nov 30
Four-month ban aimed at lifting prices
China prices already at three-month high
outlooks.summary: The DRC is halting cobalt exports again for four months, a major supply cut. Prices are down 24% over 3 months, so only part of the move is priced in and more upside is likely.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the Nov 30 start date, any quota details, and Chinese inventory draws.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)将再次暂停钴出口四个月,属重大供应削减。价格三个月下跌24%,目前仅部分反映,仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)自11月30日起重新实施钴出口禁令
为提振价格实施四个月禁令
中国钴价已升至三个月高点
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月30日禁令生效、配额细节以及中国库存消耗情况。

drivers: China extends suspension of export curbs to US
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly generic critical-mineral news with little molybdenum-specific supply news. The price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for molybdenum-specific mine or export news and the January 2027 expiry of China's suspension.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为泛关键矿产消息,几乎没有钼的具体供应消息。价格三个月上涨18%,12个月上涨42%。
drivers_zh: 中国延长对美出口管制暂停期
泰国化学品出口禁令(间接影响)
铜冶炼厂供应紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注钼矿或出口的具体消息,以及中国暂停措施在2027年1月到期情况。

drivers: Zimbabwe export tax and 2027 ban plans
Weak end-use demand, prices at lows
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe policy is a bullish risk but is a longer-term matter, and the CATL restart adds supply. Demand is weak and prices are down 13% in 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Zimbabwe's final export rules and the Jianxiawo mine's output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦政策带来偏多风险,但属较长期问题,而宁德时代枧下窝矿复产增加供应。需求疲弱,价格三个月下跌13%。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂出口税及2027年禁令计划
宁德时代枧下窝锂矿复产
终端需求疲弱,价格处于低位
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦最终出口规则以及枧下窝矿的产量。

drivers: China expands rare earth export controls
Thailand bans mining chemical exports to Myanmar
Laos rare earth operations suspended after dam breach
outlooks.summary: Several supply hits stack up: wider Chinese controls, loss of Myanmar mining chemicals and a Laos suspension. Price is up 36% in 12 months but only 4% in 3 months, so more upside is plausible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Myanmar output after the Thai chemical ban and any new Chinese licensing steps.
outlooks.summary_zh: 多项供应冲击叠加:中国扩大管制、缅甸采矿化学品供应中断以及老挝暂停作业。价格12个月上涨36%,但三个月仅涨4%,仍可能上行。
drivers_zh: 中国扩大稀土出口管制
泰国禁止向缅甸出口采矿化学品
老挝尾矿池溃坝后稀土作业暂停
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注泰国化学品禁令后缅甸的产量,以及中国新的许可措施。

drivers: Thai chemical export ban and Myanmar issues
outlooks.summary: Supply is tight from Congo and Indonesia disruptions, and prices are up 56% in 12 months but flat over 3 months. Much is priced in, though risks remain tilted up.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and any Congo mine disruption.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产使供应偏紧,价格12个月上涨56%,但近三个月持平。大部分已被计价,但风险仍偏向上行。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突与印尼减产
泰国化学品出口禁令及缅甸问题
铜冶炼厂供应紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量以及刚果矿山是否出现中断。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
outlooks.summary: A mine halt is bullish, but China's extended suspension of curbs to the US eases pressure. Prices have fallen sharply over a year, suggesting ample supply.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Chinese mine stays shut and the January 2027 expiry.
outlooks.summary_zh: 矿山停产偏多,但中国延长对美出口管制暂停期缓解压力。价格一年大幅下跌,显示供应充裕。
drivers_zh: 中国一大型锑矿停产
中国延长对美出口暂停期
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注该中国矿山停产时间以及2027年1月的到期情况。

drivers: China extends export-curb suspension to US
outlooks.summary: The suspension extension eases near-term pressure, and the price has already jumped 67% in 3 months. Military-use bans remain, so the risk is balanced.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the January 2027 expiry and any new Chinese licensing moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 暂停期延长缓解近期压力,且价格三个月已大涨67%。军用禁令仍在,风险大致平衡。
drivers_zh: 中国延长对美出口管制暂停期
各国资助中国以外的供应
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注2027年1月到期情况以及中国新的许可举措。

outlooks.summary: Refinery disruptions are bullish, but the Americas glut and coal switching limit the upside. Price is up 15% over 3 months, so some tightness is already priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast refinery restarts and further refinery strikes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂扰动偏多,但美洲过剩和转用煤炭限制上行空间。价格三个月上涨15%,部分紧张已被计价。
drivers_zh: 炼厂袭击与停产
美洲重质原油过剩
转用煤炭的风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂复产及后续炼厂遇袭情况。

outlooks.summary: Mixed signals: outages support prices, but a regional glut and coal switching cap gains. The index is down 5% over 3 months and the supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast restarts, freight rates and the petcoke-coal price gap.
outlooks.summary_zh: 信号不一:停产支撑价格,但区域过剩和转用煤炭限制涨幅。指数三个月下跌5%,供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 炼厂袭击与停产
美洲重质原油过剩
石油焦与煤炭价差收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注墨西哥湾沿岸复产、运费以及石油焦与煤炭的价差。
